flagged.evidence: Step 1.1 asserts that for the null exceptional set of F, “the one-dimensional area estimate says that g'=0 almost everywhere on the inverse image of that exceptional set.” Its declared dependencies provide neither that weighted inverse-image estimate nor a proof of it. In particular, the definition of property (N) explicitly says it is “an image condition” that “asserts nothing about preimages of null sets,” while the cited AC-to-(N) theorem states only that every AC function has property (N). The sharp FTC supplies F'=f off a null set, but does not license pulling that exceptional set back through g with the asserted derivative-zero conclusion. This substantive area-formula step is essential to steps 2.1 and 3.1.
